messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Sev2 - Build Pipeline failure (GitHub Actions/Packages). Impacts hotfix CI and deploys. Incident doc: https://redwoodincidents.internal/INC-2026-0315

maria (oncall): seeing multiple failing workflows for the hotfix PR. Build step fails while pulling private packages from GitHub Packages. Start time ~00:04 UTC. Repro logs below.

kevin (infra): confirmed. GH Actions job shows 503 from npm.pkg.github.com during npm install.

sara (eng): this blocks the hotfix for the edge-case bug — need a deploy within the hour if possible.

maria (oncall): paste of Actions job run log:
```
npm ERR! code E502
npm ERR! 502 Bad Gateway - GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/@our-scope/private-lib - Service Unavailable
(node:1234) UnhandledPromiseRejectionWarning: Request failed with status code 502
```

dinesh (sre): quick triage: seems GitHub Packages and Actions are degraded per status page. CI failing at package fetch step. We should avoid depending on GH-hosted runners/registry for the hotfix. Options: 1) run jobs on self-hosted runners and point to registry.npmjs.org or our Artifactory proxy; 2) manually build artifact locally and push container image; 3) pull tarball of the private package from the last release via GitHub Releases API if available.

kevin (infra): I can spin up a fleet of self-hosted runners in us-west1 and run the workflow there. Starting runner bootstrap now. Command:
```
./actions-runner/run.sh --start --labels fallback,us-west
```

sara (eng): note: some packages are private and only hosted in GitHub Packages (no mirror). If GH Packages is down, switching registry won't help for those unless we have cached copies or rebuilds.

eva (security): any registry change must preserve token usage. If using internal Artifactory, ensure nousers/pats are rotated. Don't expose PATs in public logs. We can use short-lived GitHub App tokens if necessary.

maria (oncall): opening case with GitHub Support: https://support.github.com/ticket/INC12345678 — included logs and workflow run ids. Pinged account manager.

incident-bot: GitHub status: https://www.githubstatus.com/ — Services: Actions degraded performance, Packages partial outage. Last updated 00:12 UTC.

ben (cs): tracking customer impact: internal alert shows 12 customers with delayed processing tied to this hotfix. No data lost, just delayed jobs and some web UI failing to show latest config. I'll draft a status blurb for ops-status (no ETA yet).

dinesh (sre): if GH doesn't restore in <1h, plan B: manual build and push container. Steps:
```
# build from commit
docker build -t gcr.io/redwood/hotfix:commit-abc123 .
docker push gcr.io/redwood/hotfix:commit-abc123
kubectl set image deployment/frontend frontend=gcr.io/redwood/hotfix:commit-abc123 -n prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/frontend -n prod
```

kevin (infra): I've pushed a temp PR that adds a workflow path for self-hosted runners and falls back to using our Artifactory proxy for registry. PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/redwood/pull/4987

sara (eng): testing with self-hosted runner now. Starting to run npm install with registry override:
```
npm set registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
npm ci
```
Install succeeded on the runner — private-only packages still failed (as expected). For those, I'm preparing a tarball from our last good build artifact.

maria (oncall): I will start the handoff in 30m. @kevin will take over active mitigation. I'll update the incident doc and the customer comms draft. Ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:

kevin (infra): taking over in 30m. I'll coordinate deploy if needed and continue the runner/PR work. If GH support provides a patch, we'll revert temporary workflow changes.

incident-bot: Update: GitHub updated status at 00:45 UTC — Actions restored for some regions but Packages still affected. Keep this channel updated. :information_source:

maria (oncall): final note before handoff — prioritize: 1) unblock hotfix via self-hosted/manual build; 2) notify customers with ETA; 3) revert temporary infra changes after GH full recovery. Leaving docs/links in incident doc.

kevin (infra): acknowledged. Continuing work. If anyone needs me, @kevin.
